descriptive_name_cn: C46六成权益与三层流动性收益增强进取策略
economic_hypothesis: Keep C45's exact sixty-percent equity, twenty-percent gold and fifteen-percent long-duration budgets, but replace four percentage points of modeled-zero cash with three independently managed one-percent fixed-income-plus routes and one percent short policy-bank debt while retaining one percent operational cash.
single_conceptual_change_from_parent: Only the five-percent C45 cash sleeve changes: three percent becomes a three-manager carry ladder, one percent becomes short policy-bank debt and one percent remains cash.
why_not_more_equity: C45 already holds sixty percent nominal equity and the rejected C45-Aggressive-2 five-percent ChiNext experiment added only 0.0235 percentage points of CAGR while worsening drawdown, Calmar and rolling-three-year results.

historical_availability_routes.long_duration: Use actual 511010 NAV before 003376 is observable, then charge a costed next-common-session transition to 003376.
historical_availability_routes.short_policy_bank_debt: Use the H00140 total-return proxy net of 30bp annual fee before 007169 is available, then charge a costed transition to actual 007169 accumulated NAV.
historical_availability_routes.current_investor_rule: Historical bridge instruments are evidence plumbing, not current targets. Current targets are 003376 and 007169 after same-session product and channel checks.

decision_rule.observation_clock: After all natural month-end common-session NAVs are knowable
decision_rule.action_at_or_above_trigger: Restore every sleeve to its frozen target
decision_rule.execution_clock: Next common NAV or subscription session after the decision date
decision_rule.new_cash_rule: Fund underweight sleeves first before creating avoidable redemptions

cost_and_delay_protocol.turnover_definition: Cost is charged to half-L1 one-way traded notional; full-L1 turnover is twice that value.

deterministic_role_stress.warning: These are deterministic simultaneous role shocks, not VaR, probabilities or a guaranteed maximum loss.

pre_performance_correction.reason: Applying the already frozen route-specific 25%, 20% and 20% extreme shocks produced a 45.1167% loss, above the 45% ceiling.
pre_performance_correction.corrected_structure_frozen_before_perfor: Three percent carry, one percent short policy-bank debt and one percent cash.

negative_precursor.change: Replace five percentage points of quality-growth equity with actual 159915 ChiNext exposure.
